name: recording
title_zh: 录屏、截图、操作手册一次打包的交付证据生成器
tagline_zh: MR/PR 里贴链接总被追问「怎么证明能跑」？它按你给的页面步骤，自动录操作视频、截关键帧、写清 runbook。
tagline_en: Tired of 'prove it works' on every MR? Feed it page steps, get a recording, screenshots, and a runbook—reviewers.
desc_en: Record evidence of a web app — an operation video, screenshots and a runbook — for a pull or merge request, a report, or a hand-off. Use when someone asks for proof that a change works, hands over an MR/PR link, or describes a page and the steps to capture on it.
why_zh: 不是散装三件套，而是把「录屏—截图—文字步骤」对齐到同一时间轴，产物彼此印证，证据链完整。
why_en: Not three loose tools—it aligns video, shots, and text on one timeline, so every claim is cross-verified. Hand-offs skip the.
limit_zh: 只认你描述得清的页面步骤；录屏依赖本机屏幕捕获权限，无 GUI 环境跑不了。产物是素材包，不代写 MR 描述或测试结论。
limit_en: Needs explicit page steps; requires local screen-capture permission, no headless. Outputs raw evidence—won't draft your MR summary or verdict.
title_en: Bundle screen recording, shots & runbook into one evidence.
